[A legit stand-in for the new Pyre]

Toggle the former Pyre. While it is active, in boss fights the enemies who die feed an otherworldly flame that strengthens the surviving enemies, and the more fiercely and quickly you fight, the stronger it grows. The rite can be dispelled: it is put out by acid and radiant damage, by healing the enemies, or by their failed Saving Throw of Constitution.
